# fipe-data-pipeline

Agent quick reference for using this repository.

## First run

Requirements: Bun 1.3.12 and Docker.

Canonical onboarding: README.md. Architecture: docs/architecture.md. Operations: docs/operations.md.

Development quickstart:

```bash
cp .env.example .env
bun install --frozen-lockfile
docker compose up -d --wait
bun run db:migrate
bun run crawl -- --brand 59 --year 2024 --month 6
```

Common commands:

```bash
bun run status
bun run classify
bun run backup
bun run restore-drill
bun run lint
bun run format
bun run typecheck
bun run check
bun run test
bun run test:integration
bun run docs:check
bun run hooks:install
```

Do not use npm as the primary flow.

## Scoped crawl

Use `bun run crawl -- ...` and pass crawler flags after `--`.

Examples:

```bash
bun run crawl -- --year 2024
bun run crawl -- --year 2020-2024
bun run crawl -- --year 2020,2022,2024
bun run crawl -- --month 1-6
bun run crawl -- --brand 59
bun run crawl -- --brand 21,22,59
bun run crawl -- --brand 59 --model 5940
bun run crawl -- --reference 328
bun run crawl -- --classify
bun run crawl -- --force
```

`--classify` classifies new models with AI. `--force` resets checkpoints and re-fetches only the selected scope. Resume failures without --force. The crawler does not always re-fetch everything by default. --model requires --brand; --reference conflicts with --year and --month. Failed items produce exit code 1. A scoped run does not establish full reference coverage.

## Classification

`ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` is optional. It is used for classificação de segmentos only.

Classification commands:

```bash
bun run crawl -- --classify
bun run classify
bun run classify -- --dry-run
```

A normal crawl does not require `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`.

## Docker and environment

Docker with an external database reachable from the container (localhost refers to the container):

```bash
docker build -t fipe-crawler .
docker run -d --name fipe --env-file .env fipe-crawler
docker exec fipe bun src/index.ts crawl --brand 25 --year 2024 --month 6
docker exec fipe bun src/index.ts status
```

For local PostgreSQL use `docker compose --profile pipeline up -d --build --wait`, then `docker compose exec pipeline bun src/db/migrate.ts`. The pipeline service uses postgres:5432, while the host uses localhost:5433.

Main env vars: DATABASE_URL, RATE_LIMIT_MS, MAX_THROTTLE_MS, MAX_RETRIES. Optional proxy: FIPE_PROXY.

## Backup and restore drill

Backup and restore-drill use S3-compatible R2 storage. They do not affect normal crawl.

Required backup env vars: R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID, R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, R2_ENDPOINT, R2_BUCKET.

Native backup requires pg_dump, pg_restore, psql and AWS CLI; the image includes them. Restore drill requires CREATEDB and uses a unique scratch database. Cleanup failures return failure.

Retention facts from the code:

- daily backups use prefix `daily/`
- monthly backups use prefix `monthly/`
- `DAILY_KEEP` is the constant 14 (files, not days)
- `MONTHLY_KEEP` is the constant 12 (monthly files)

## Schema and source

Schema tables: reference_tables, brands, models, model_years, prices.

Relationship:

```text
reference_tables --> prices
brands --> models --> model_years --> prices
```

Source data: veiculos.fipe.org.br. Atualização: Mensal. Cobertura: Carros, motos, caminhões e utilitários.

The provider covers Carros, motos, caminhões e utilitários; this pipeline requests category 1 only. Current schema: src/db/schema.ts. Migrations: drizzle/. No second editable SQL schema exists. The consumer owns latest_prices; REFRESH_LATEST_PRICES=false by default, true requires that materialized view and its unique index.
